properties.name: BFR53
properties.notes: The site comprises a large building (formerly a hotel and then flats) set in extensive grounds which are used for the storage of caravans. Bounded by Botsom Lane to the north, a residential dwelling to the west, caravan site to the east and open countryside to the south. Mature trees line the boundaries of the site.
properties.site-address: Stanwell House, Botsom Lane, West Kingsdown
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
